description: Source code implementing the MimeType class for parsing and handling MIME type strings, including parameter parsing, validation, and string conversion.

classes.name: MimeType

methods.description: Constructor that parses a MIME type string into type, subtype, and parameters.

methods.description: Returns the type of a parameter at a given index.

methods.description: Retrieves float value of a parameter by index or name.

methods.name: GetParamStringValue

methods.name: GetParamBoolValue
